name: unbake-proto
description: Decompile baked protobuf descriptors into human-readable working .proto
author: ph0ryn

scripts.format: pnpm run lint --fix . ; bunx oxfmt . ; bunx eslint --fix .
scripts.prepack: pnpm run precommit && clean-pkg-json -r dependencies -r peerDependencies && pnpm run build
scripts.precommit: pnpm run check && pnpm run format
scripts.test:proto2: protoc --descriptor_set_out=test/descriptor.pb --include_imports test/descriptor.proto && bun run unbake test/descriptor.pb
scripts.test:proto3: protoc --descriptor_set_out=test/comprehensive.pb --include_imports test/comprehensive.proto && bun run unbake test/comprehensive.pb
